name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-06-19.23.1), moved by South Australian Senator [Don Farrell](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/don_farrell) (Labor), to a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-06-19.22.1) moved by South Australian Senator [Sarah Hanson-Young](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/sarah_hanson-young) (Greens). This means the amendment failed. ### Amendment text > *Omit "16 October 2023", substitute "the next day of sitting".* ### Original motion text > *That, to allow time for National Cabinet to progress reforms to strengthen renters' rights as advised in the Prime Minister's press release of 28 April 2023, including reforms to limit rent increases, further consideration of the Housing Australia Future Fund Bill 2023 and two related bills be made an order of the day for 16 October 2023.*
